notes.title: Our new pinball game, Pinball FX, is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
We are glad to present you our new pinball game! Pinball FX is now available on Steam with more than 100 unique and visually enhanced tables from our library. And there is more to come!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2328760?utm_source=steamnews

Play for free

The game arrives with three free-to-play tables. Discover the castle's dusty cellar and face new challenges on Sorcerer’s Lair, catch the biggest fishes on your way to the top of the leaderboards on Fish Tales™, and play as Cindy, a tough-as-nails frontier bounty hunter in the Old West on Wild West Rampage. 

Complete the tutorial to unlock a 1-day Pinball Pass subscription for free giving you a chance to try more than 70 other tables!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43901061/6b1ab9af260b3759e1618efd179479a2d296c988.jpg

Discover brand new exclusive tables created for Pinball FX and relive the most iconic moments from entertainment powerhouses like Indiana Jones, Star Wars, Marvel, Universal Studios, and many more.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31647?utm_source=steamnews

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31645?utm_source=steamnews


Dive into the fantastic universes of brand-new tables like Crypt of the NecroDancer Pinball, Twilight Zone™, and Godzilla vs. Kong Pinball Pack!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2351845?utm_source=steamnews

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2351844?utm_source=steamnews

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2351807?utm_source=steamnews

Enjoy digital pinball at its finest as Pinball FX brings you the most advanced simulation in pinball with Pro Physics for every table in the library, 4K HDR visuals, and ray tracing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43901061/81b69d2a7af616811733f4cffe721d0f205b0cbe.jpg

Enter the new era of digital pinball and start your conquest on more than 600 different leaderboards!

The Zen Studios Team

notes.title: Step Right Up - our new RPG Circus Electrique is Out Now!
notes.content:
Come one come all and start your adventure! 

Circus Electrique is now available to play.

[previewyoutube=K6FfAtET9nA;full][/previewyoutube]

When everyday Londoners mysteriously turn into vicious killers, only the circus’ lineup of Strongmen, Fire Blowers, Clowns and other performers possess the unique talents necessary to save the city. Through tactical turn-based battles, these unlikely heroes face Bobbies, British Sailors gone bad, aggressive Posh Girls, and other Victorian-era archetypes stand in their way – not to mention the occasional menacing Mime or Robobear. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41628058/fbcc4df1c75075a2e6fa79e16e07bdee6207f62d.jpg

 Start managing the greatest show in London today:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1666250/Circus_Electrique/

Or check out the Soundtrack created by Hungarian composer, Arthur Valentin Grósz:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2052860/Circus_Electrique_Soundtrack/

Explore the amazing art and get a head start in your exploration with the Artbook & Maps pack:

notes.title: Star Wars™ Pinball VR is finally here! Get on the leaderboards today!
notes.content:
Hey Golfers!

Check out our brand new game, Star Wars™ Pinball VR, which is now available to play on Steam VR! Jump into a galaxy far, far away once again, and immerse yourself in virtual reality pinball!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1530770?utm_source=steam&utm_medium_IMG

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/6eddff33588b7825bf28612e0254176a9a861244.png


 The “Fan Cave”: The new home for your pinball table, plus the customizable array of Star Wars lightsabers, blasters, helmets, and more you’ll earn while playing. Start up a new table and life-sized characters and vehicles join you on either side.
 The Mandalorian: The excitement of the first season translated into VR pinball goodness. Take bounties, protect the Child, and meet characters like IG-11 or Moff Gideon. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/542fed09cc0927bf1b1c2cf59df30aa80614ea3f.png


 Total Immersion Mode: Stand side-by-side with your favorite characters and experience everything at table level.
 Full 360-Degree Mini-Games: Dive into iconic Star Wars set pieces like the speeder bike chase on Endor, the Bespin carbon-freezing chamber duel, and others.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/caccc229c3c425bbafe53f7506d140e3034fd75d.png


 Career Mode: Play bite-sized challenges designed to make you a better player! Progress through missions, and become the ultimate pinball wizard. 


In addition, enjoy classic Star Wars™ Pinball features like Force powers, competitive gameplay, haptic controller feedback, your own personal cantina jukebox, and more!

The only thing you need to do now is don your VR headset, press play, and start getting those jackpots! 

The Zen Team

notes.title: Zen news: Dread Nautical Arrived on Steam with a 40% Launch Discount!

I'd like to intrude with a little cross-promo for our title 'Dread Nautical'. Might be worth checking out?

notes.title: Dread Nautical Sails to Steam on October 27!
notes.content:
Dread Nautical, the creepiest tactical RPG you'll ever play arrives on Steam on October 27 - just in time for Halloween!

Please wishlist today!

[previewyoutube=K4r_kWqyfFY;full][/previewyoutube]

Hi Golfers! This is not strictly minigolf, but we thought you might be interested in our new release!

Get into the spirit as one of four unlikely survivors:

Miraje, a lounge singer who’s not going down with this ship
Hatano, a katana-wielding badass with a troubled past
Vi, a young gamer who will need to grow up fast
Fargo, a personal investigator who’s too old for this ****

A tactical turn-based RPG with roguelike elements, Dread Nautical combines immersive gameplay with a colorful, but deeply eldritch tone. Supernatural forces have overwhelmed a cruise liner called Hope whisking away the entire clientele and crew to a different dimension.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34070339/be35240b51cf7337404bac0f52d8f24c0a9bf88f.jpg

Manage your scarce resources effectively, and convince scattered survivors to fight alongside you. You’ll need them for any hope of escaping this “vacation” alive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34070339/44e2a9eef15c83635d56e93f9a9783c08ba4fb2f.jpg

Traverse all 20 decks of the to unlock the mysteries of the Hope. Think several steps ahead during each battle, plotting the optimal use of each character’s action points. Your weapons, bandages, and other items deteriorate, and your resources are very limited. Make sure your companions rest, or panic may overtake them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34070339/42542773098734dbfc655e3721ee373c0287c737.gif

Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/ZenIndies

notes.title: HO! HO! HO! Santa’s Factory Update is Now Available for Infinite Minigolf!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26476557/e44988b9e410d18c3da568e8981c3c86693c5f2e.png
Dive into a winter wonderland with Infinite Minigolf’s latest course, Santa’s Factory! In time for the holiday season, Santa’s Factory takes players on a journey to the North Pole, hands down the best place to get in some rounds of minigolf this time of the year. Grab your candy canes, hockey sticks and golf clubs and hit the links with Santa and his reindeer for some festive holiday fun as the Santa’s Factory update is available now for Infinite Minigolf in Steam Early Access!

https://youtu.be/bY5KNq2tVX0

In addition to the new theme, we have also introduced a new feature: the Hole Browser. Players can now search and filter player created holes and assemble your own custom courses from them. Challenge your friends on your own courses in local or online multiplayer matches, with support for up to eight players!

notes.title: 8-players Multiplayer Update!
notes.content:
In the last two weeks we were busy developing and testing 8-players online multiplayer mode, and now we invite you to try this frantic match type! We have also made an important change in scoring: now every hole-in-one in multiplayer matches doubles the score of the next hole, which adds some neat strategic opportunities.

We have also added the in-game Store, where you can purchase card packs with your coins earned from completing Quick Missions. This will allow you unlock avatar items faster.

I hope you will like the new features, and stay tuned for the third theme coming in the next update!

notes.title: Multiplayer Update!
notes.content:
We hope you are enjoying Infinite Minigolf so far! We’ve added several new features today:
Online multiplayer for 2-4 players 
Private matches
Party invites
Social links, plus a link to our Discord channel. We welcome players to discuss Infinite Minigolf with us! 
Inbox for in-game messages: You’ll receive messages for various reasons, for example, when a friend breaks your record, shares a new custom course or other activities. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26476557/11f1887037af1b873029a015a959a55adfba6e13.jpg

In the coming weeks, we'll add:

Special match rules (ball interaction, no power-ups, etc.) 
8 player support for online multiplayer 
Course selection: Choose your own course, rather than playing a course at random

Let us know if you have any suggestions for themes or features you’d like to see in Infinite Minigolf! 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26476557/f24b0a9e65fc20d4a1cf9fc40c1574d91370611a.jpg

notes.title: Halloween Mansion update is released!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26476557/5264453cb2e1a614875ef7145fe8aafc58d82f5c.png
Shocktober is wrapping up and we couldn’t be more excited to deliver you the first big update for Infinite Minigolf: a brand new theme that’s filled with spooks and scares in celebration of the season. Enter the door to the Halloween Mansion and play through brand new holes, tricky traps and haunted obstacles inside, or create your own otherwordly courses using the brand new tileset, objects and decorations. Be aware that the Halloween Mansion tileset is made of stone, making your ball bounce and roll more than it does on the cardboard cutout courses in Giant Home.

We’ve also got some good news for local multiplayer fans too: we’ve increased the maximum player count to 8, something that should be useful for big Halloween parties!

We’ve updated the reward system as well, so you’ll get instant rewards for the following deeds in Quick Play mode:

Playing on a hole from the ’New’ category
Surpassing the ’Target’ score for the first time on a hole
Beating the ’World Record’ on a hole

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26476557/df6ab7da788d3c8e7e3909c699e04ec13b9f2afd.png
Also, a quick glance into the future: Online Multiplayer is releasing in early November, and the third theme is coming in early December. 

Have a happy Halloween, minigolf fans!

notes.title: Early Access Release!!!
notes.content:
So here we are, after all those years finally delivering the long awaited sequel to fan-favorite Planet Minigolf. Ok, it's not finished yet, but it's already very much playable and fun, with:


probably the best minigolf gameplay/physics around 
easy-to-use hole editor
content sharing system, providing unlimited content
cartoon-quality graphics and animation
customizable characters with lots of unlockable clothing options
family-friendly tone
hot-seat local multiplayer
full controller and keyboard-mouse support
original upbeat soundtrack by CastleStorm-composer Waterflame


We are going to update the game with new content and features on a regular basis until its full release in Q1 2017. Please check the related Discussions topic for a full roadmap.

We would like to invite you to create and share content that surprises even us. We have built the game so that you have the ability to create endless content, and we are really excited to see what you will do with these tools! We are also looking for feedback and ideas through our community channels.

Thank you for reading this, and have fun with Infinite Minigolf! :)
